title: Artifacts: The Galois action on the seven M23 Hurwitz points
description: Computational artifacts for the paper: machine-checkable receipts, the full numerical pipeline (power-series models, marked Petri invariants, trace/norm descent, exact sextic recognition, Frobenius inventory, 23-adic certificates), Magma referee scripts with verbatim ledgers, and the in-progress Lean 4 formalization of the finite combinatorial core. One-command reproduction from the stored solver outputs to every table in the paper (pipeline/reproduce_p100.py).
notes: After the paper is posted, add {relation: isSupplementTo, identifier: arXiv:<paper id>} and re-deposit.
